rows.en:
{C:81930400}{C:81958296C73400000000}Quick question.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296C83400000000}Hm?

{C:81930400}{C:81958296C93400000000}Before we start,
have you ever used
the items carried aboard the ship?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296CA3400000000}No, I haven't.
Why do you ask?

{C:81930400}{C:81958296CB3400000000}Then I'll teach you now, so remember this.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296CC3400000000}Yeah, please do.

{C:81930400}{C:81958296CD3400000000}First, to use an item,
you need to select this part of the menu.


{x00}

rows.en:
{C:81930400}{C:81958296CE3400000000}Like deploying units,
using the items displayed here
consumes the ship's EN.

{C:81958296CF3400000000}And once an item has been used,
once per turn,

{C:81958296D03400000000}at the time when units would be repaired,
the item may be readied again
instead of the units being repaired.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296D13400000000}Instead of the units?

{C:81930400}{C:81958296D23400000000}Yes.
So, if an item
is readied again,

{C:81958296D33400000000}you need to remember that
the units won't be repaired.


{C:81958296D43400000000}Also, if you use up an item
that has a limited number of uses,
you can't use it again during that battle.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296D53400000000}So I have to be careful
not to waste them... This is tricky.

{C:81930400}{C:81958296D63400000000}Next,
I'll explain the types of items.

{C:81958296D73400000000}They have all sorts of effects,
so it's quicker to read their descriptions
or actually try using them.

{C:81958296D83400000000}But their targets fall
into just three broad categories,
so those should be easy to remember.

{C:81958296D93400000000}First, 
{C:819782830600}items the ship equips and uses{C:819782830000}

{C:81958296DA3400000000}Once used, this type of item
continually boosts the ship's capabilities.
...For example, this one.


{x00}

rows.en:
{C:81930400}{C:81958296DB3400000000}With this, your maximum EN
stays increased throughout this battle.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296DC3400000000}Hey, what do we gain
from increasing the maximum?

{C:81930400}{C:81958296DD3400000000}Oh, honestly...

{C:81958296DE3400000000}A higher maximum means
you can carry more EN over, right?
Don't you get it?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296DF3400000000}Oh! So less goes to waste,
and we can attack all at once next time!

{C:81930400}{C:81958296E03400000000}That's right.
Now, on to the next type.

{C:81958296E13400000000}{C:819782830600}Items that restore or build up
points for ships or units{C:819782830000}

{C:81958296E23400000000}These two are examples.
First, the one
used on a unit.


{x00}

rows.en:
{C:81930400}{C:81958296E43400000000}Both do just what you saw,
so there's no need to explain further.

{C:81958296E53400000000}Last, I'll explain 
{C:819782830600}items for which you specify
a location on the battlefield{C:819782830000}

{C:81958296E73400000000}The items we've covered so far
take effect the moment you use them,
but these are different.

{C:81958296E83400000000}You send these items onto the field
at a specified time during battle
to provide support.

{C:81958296E93400000000}So you need to specify their Speed
and where to send them.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296EA3400000000}...Speed and location?

{C:81930400}{C:81958296EB3400000000}Yes.
Anyway, I think you'll understand
once you see for yourself.


{x00}

rows.en:
{C:81930400}{C:81958296EC3400000000}For Speed,
each item has a base Speed.

{C:81958296ED3400000000}By spending additional EN,
you can change it within the range
fixed for that item.

{C:81958296EE3400000000}And even at the same Speed,
an item's effect occurs before a unit acts.

{C:81958296EF3400000000}As for location,
each item has its own
specified range.

{C:81958296F03400000000}Anyway,
each item's capabilities...

{C:81958296F13400000000}You can find them
in the descriptions displayed,
so it's best to check before using an item.

{C:81958296F23400000000}All right, I'm going on the attack!








{x00}

{C:81930400}{C:81958296F33400000000}I'll leave the rest to you, then.
Let's finish this battle quickly
and set off in pursuit of the Norstan.

{x00}
